originalFamilyScopeSummary: Fix truncated decimal display for available to trade percentage on perps slider initial load
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: Fix truncated decimal display for available to trade percentage on perps slider initial load
notes: The family's root defect is fully addressed at its source rather than at the symptom. ui/hooks/perps/usePerpsOrderForm.ts seeded the initial balancePercent with Math.round(x * 100) / 100; it is the only producer of a fractional balancePercent, since the five other writers (slider step=1, size input, token input, percent field, leverage handler) all already round to whole numbers. Seeding with Math.round(x) therefore fixes the single source of truth for all three consumers of the value: the visible percentage pill, the step=1 slider thumb, and the ORDER_SIZE_PERCENT analytics property. This is a root-cause fix, not a display-layer patch, so it is not partial-symptom-only. Evidence: a dual-recipe setup in the parent run proved the delta honestly — the baseline recipe asserted the buggy values (percentValue '0.44', percentIsInteger false, percentIsClipped true via scrollWidth 50 > clientWidth 45, sliderIsOnStepGrid false) and passed on the unfixed tree, while the verify recipe asserts the fixed values and passes on the fixed tree. Re-validated in this run against branch + origin/main merged and rebuilt: 24/24 recipe nodes ok, initial load percentValue '0' integer and unclipped, post-slider-interaction percentValue '3' integer and unclipped, both screenshots from capture-helper. Two revert-sensitive unit tests cover the rounding (including the ticket's 22.22 -> 22 case) and were confirmed to fail on the reverted code. No reviewer comments were raised on the PR, so no follow-up scope emerged. The only outstanding CI red is a pre-existing flake in ui/hooks/useEventFragment.test.js, which is unrelated to this family's scope.
